title: Restricted Proof Candidate Consolidation Review
purpose: Review RPCR-001 through RPCR-009 and determine whether MT-001/002/003 are ready for formal proof review, require added preconditions, or remain blocked.
review_findings: Proof obligations for MT-001, MT-002, and MT-003 are explicitly defined and traceable to FSUB.
Assumption audits confirm that all candidates remain within the STRICTLY_LOCAL_RESTRICTED_DOMAIN.
Candidate reviews for MT-001/002/003 show support under explicitly declared assumptions (A1-A3).
Counterexamples (e.g., orientation locking, projection non-idempotence) are successfully mapped and preserved.
Proof strength classification provides a non-inflationary hierarchy for candidate evaluation.
Stress tests verify that the governance layer blocks hidden globality and unauthorized theorem promotion.
The framework successfully incorporates the 'recursively inseparable aspects' conceptual breakthrough.
remaining_risks: Supported status under assumptions is not a proof; formal review must scrutinize the granted assumptions.
Counterexamples represent active boundaries that must be accounted for in any final proof attempt.
The transition to formal review requires the satisfaction of additional FSUB-derived preconditions.
forbidden_next_steps: Claiming theorem proof from candidate support.
Claiming physical relevance from local theorem readiness.
Claiming global closure from MT success.
